## What the schema cannot express

Describe the field, relationship, or act structure that has no home in the
canonical schema — or that the schema forces into a shape that loses information.

## Why the current shape loses something

Be specific about what a downstream user would get wrong. "It is untidy" is not
a defect; "two different people collapse into one record" is.

## Suggested shape, if you have one

Optional. A counterexample is valuable on its own.
